set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Day-based puzzle
set.stimulus:
Seven persons — A, B, C, D, E, F and G — go to a music class on different days of the same week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday. Only one person goes on each day. Each of them likes a different fruit — Plum, Cherry, Banana, Pear, Mango, Apple and Pineapple.

5. A likes Pineapple.
6. Neither G nor B goes on Wednesday.
7. As many persons go before G as after C.
8. Only one person goes between E and the one who likes Cherry.
9. The one who likes Pineapple does not go immediately after or immediately before the one who likes Cherry.
10. F goes immediately after the one who likes Banana.
11. D goes on one of the days before Thursday.
